because: Counterexample (hunt round 4, 2026-10-12): emit_drop_event_sampled never wrote payload (256 of 300 bytes); bpf_ringbuf_reserve does not zero, so after the ring wrapped the field carried other packets' bytes, against the ABI comment 'the kernel side sets them all'.
statement: Every byte of a DropEvent record the XDP program submits to the events ring is written between reserve and submit, so no record carries bytes of an earlier one.
